doc.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 23, 2003 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Fiftieth anniversary and his wife's help
summary: His wife helps with his career and handles business and mail.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Almost makes me want to take up the guitar. Well you know I wanted also to congratulate you on your upcoming fiftieth anniversary.
Oh yeah, yeah, yeah that’s right.
It sounds like she’s been a great help in your career.
Oh very big, yeah. Sometimes she sits in the audience and tells me when to change the chord.
She’s a good listener then. Does she handle some of your business?

All the time, yeah, everything. You know I wake up in the morning and you know I don’t realize it but every morning we’ve got a stack of mail, we’ve got this and that, and by the time it’s twelve noon and we still haven’t made four phone calls. But it’s good that way, I’m not complaining.
